entities.name: Pekalongan Batik Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: This museum has a land and building area of 40 square meters and has 1149 collections of batik, including wayang beber made of batik cloth that is hundreds of years old and traditional looms or known as non-machine looms. Located in Indonesia. Founded 1972.
